title: CAFEIN – Federated Learning Platform
summary: CERN describes operational federated model training and analysis across institutions, with intended benefits for research and privacy-preserving collaboration.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: CAFEIN uses federated averaging to train models across locally held datasets, with secure aggregation and privacy protections. CERN describes the platform as operationally used. Its intended benefit is collaborative model-assisted analysis without centralizing sensitive records. The source does not quantify an analytical improvement or resulting patient outcome. Partnerships and hosting are context, rather than separate AI-produced gains.
purpose: Support collaborative model-assisted research while keeping sensitive data local.

ratings.reason: Federated model training and analysis are described as operational, but an improvement in research output or analytical performance is not quantified.
Patient-care improvements are intended downstream effects of the model-assisted research.
More equitable access to collaborative AI research is intended; listed partnerships alone do not establish that outcome.

ai_role.statement: Federated learning combines model updates from local datasets to support collaborative analysis; model inference is also planned.

evidence.citation: Contributed use case in International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact, 2025. Information current as of June 2025. The reported outcomes are attributed to the submitting project, not an independent outcome evaluation by ITU.
evidence.title: Use Case 3: CAFEIN – Federated Learning Platform

produced_by: The contributor describes the application and its setting in the cited entry. Conditions sufficient to reproduce the reported benefit have not been established.
must_hold: Requirements for reproducing the benefit need to be evaluated in the new setting. The collection entry does not establish that its reported results will recur.

headline: CAFEIN trains research models without centralizing sensitive data

revisions.change: Added the sourced case with separate benefit depth, beneficiary, evidence confidence, and outcome status assessments.

claim_basis: The makers' report is on file. There is no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
